task: 42-class closed-set syndrome classification (generative formulation, aligned with frozen Qwen3 SFT)

layer_mapping_rule.semantics: Stage1 = higher-layer sub-interval (semantic anchor); Stage2 = expanded mid-to-high sub-interval (reasoning expansion).
layer_mapping_rule.frozen_reference_note: Qwen3-8B 实际 num_hidden_layers=36 (local config.json)。v18 config.py 设计区间: STAGE1_OPEN_LAYERS=23..31, STAGE2_OPEN_LAYERS=12..31 (该标注基于当时的 32 层假设写成, 后经本地 config.json 核实为 36 层)。v19.1 起按【设计区间】双边界等比映射: 开区间 [start, end) 的 start 与 end 两个边界都乘以 L/36, 而非只缩放 start 后一路延伸到 L-1 (v19.0 规则, 等价于把 v18 因 32 层假设而未列层的顶部也等比放大给 InternLM, 造成覆盖比例失衡)。

resolved_layer_ranges.rule: stage1 = [round(L*23/36), round(L*32/36)); stage2 = [round(L*12/36), round(L*32/36)). L=48 → 31..42 / 16..42; L=36 → 23..31 / 12..31 (v18 设计区间)。num_hidden_layers 必须真实读取, 禁止硬编码。

changelog.rule: start 等比缩放 (round(L*23/36), round(L*12/36)) + 延伸到 L-1

changelog.change: 层区间映射公平性修正 (双边界等比映射)
changelog.reason: v19.0 规则只缩放起始边界、结束一路延伸到 L-1, 使 InternLM 覆盖比例 (35.4% / 66.7%) 明显大于 Qwen3 冻结协议设计区间 (9/36 = 25% / 20/36 = 55.6%)——相当于把 v18 因 32 层假设未列层的顶部也等比放大给 InternLM, 比较不公平。v19.1 改为按设计区间双边界等比映射 (start 与 end 均乘 L/36), 覆盖比例对齐 (25% / 56.25%)。修正发生在 InternLM3 任何训练与 held-out 推理之前, 属 protocol correction (实验设计问题), 非 test-driven tuning。

hyperparameters.loss: pure SFT cross-entropy (no KD / rule / smoothing)

template.training: system=资深中医专家(证型+辨证依据两字段); user=临床资料(input_text); assistant=证型：{syndrome}\n辨证依据：<generic evidence> (labels only on answer)
template.inference: same content via model's native chat template; do_sample=False, temperature=0, max_new_tokens=96; raw_output saved then parsed by evaluation/parse_label.py (unified parser)

comparability_notes: quantization matched to frozen Qwen3 run (config.py QUANT_BITS=4 on CUDA; build_quant_config: nf4 + double_quant + bf16 compute; artifact sft_clean_v3_bnb_nf4) — QLoRA is the frozen protocol, not an OOM fallback
layer coverage aligned to Qwen3 designed protocol interval (v19.1): 25% (stage1) / 56.25% (stage2) of 48 layers
any deviation from this protocol must be recorded in run_summary.json with reason
